race.comment: Very open with a few different angles. KOKO (4) is fit and close to a win. Tracked the pace and boxed on well last time to finish runner-up at Cranbourne. Overdue and should go close. PORTLAND ROSE (16) started big odds at debut in the Blue Diamond Prelude and was safely held in what has been a hot form race. Resuming in far easier and fitter for a trial and two jump-outs. Could well measure up. WRITTEN CHARM (13) is a filly by Written Tycoon on debut. Half to two time Group 1 winner Extreme Choice. Nicely bred and trialling well so is the big watch on the betting. SHEER PANIC (3) gave a sight fresh and fitter again sure to run well. ANNOUNCED SPEED (10) is by first season sire Lean Mean Machine out of Our Declaration. Won a Mornington jump-out and looks ready to run well.
